lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Paella Sold Out: Choosing a Substitute for Six
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Compare the dishes still available and agree with the waiter and your group on what will replace the paella.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are lunching with a group of six in Alicante, and the AI is Begoña, the waitress, with your impatient friend Raúl: ask about the dishes still available, compare them with más que and menos que, and use the future and ir a to agree on what replaces the paella.
lessons.title: Choose a Substitute Lunch for Six
lessons.objective: Compare the dishes still available and agree with the server and six-person group on a replacement for a sold-out dish.
lessons.focus: Use plus ... que, moins ... que, va prendre and sera to compare quantity, waiting time and the final plan.
lessons.scene: At a bistro, the group’s preferred shared dish has sold out; Maya asks what can serve six.

cards.fr: un gratin de pommes de terre
Le plat du jour est épuisé.
cards.en: The daily special is sold out.
The gratin will take twenty minutes.

cards.fr: La tarte sera prête dans dix minutes.
cards.en: The tart will be ready in ten minutes.

cards.fr: La tarte sera plus légère que le gratin.
cards.en: The tart will be lighter than the gratin.

cards.fr: Nous allons prendre deux tartes à partager.
cards.en: We are going to take two tarts to share.
Will that be enough for six?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous sommes six. Le plat du jour est-il encore disponible ?
reader.en: There are six of us. Is the daily special still available?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Non, il est épuisé. Nous avons encore le gratin et la tarte aux légumes.
reader.en: No, it is sold out. We still have the gratin and vegetable tart.

reader.speaker: Friend
reader.fr: J’ai faim. Quel plat arrivera le plus vite ?
reader.en: I am hungry. Which dish will arrive fastest?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Combien de temps prendra chaque plat ?
reader.en: How long will each dish take?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Le gratin prendra vingt minutes. La tarte sera prête dans dix minutes.
reader.en: The gratin will take twenty minutes. The tart will be ready in ten minutes.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: La tarte sera plus légère que le gratin. Cela suffira-t-il pour six ?
reader.en: The tart will be lighter than the gratin. Will that be enough for six?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Deux tartes feront six portions.
reader.en: Two tarts will make six portions.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le gratin sera plus copieux, mais il prendra plus de temps. Que préférez-vous ?
reader.en: The gratin will be heartier, but it will take longer. What do you prefer?

reader.speaker: Friend
reader.fr: Deux tartes, s’il vous plaît.
reader.en: Two tarts, please.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: D’accord. Nous allons prendre deux tartes à partager.
reader.en: All right. We are going to have two tarts to share.

speaking.opening: Nous sommes six. Qu’est-ce qui est encore disponible ?
speaking.goal: Ask what is available, compare the ten- and twenty-minute waits and portion sizes, get group agreement and order two tarts.
speaking.closure: Nous allons prendre deux tartes à partager.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to ask what remains available.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The quantities and wait times are fictional. Review natural comparative and future forms with a qualified French reviewer.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Two Menus, Two Prices: Sorting It Out with the Guide
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Narrate what you ordered and what each menu said, with exact numbers, to resolve a price gap with owner and guide.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a traveler in Wilmer's tour group, and the AI is Señora Quispe, the owner, with guide Wilmer present: calmly recount what you ordered and what the menu at the door said, using the preterite (pedimos, nos cobraron) and exact numbers, and ask for the itemized bill.
lessons.title: Resolve Two Lunch Prices with Exact Numbers
lessons.objective: Recount what the group ordered and what the sign said, then request an itemized bill to resolve a price difference with owner and guide.
lessons.focus: Use nous avons commandé, on nous a facturé and exact euro amounts to narrate the discrepancy.
lessons.scene: Maya and guide Luc compare the door sign with a printed bill for four fixed-price lunches and three drinks.

cards.fr: On nous a facturé cinq menus.
cards.en: We were charged for five set lunches.

cards.fr: L’affiche indique dix-huit euros par menu.
cards.en: The sign says eighteen euros per set lunch.

cards.fr: Le total attendu est de quatre-vingt-quatre euros.
cards.en: The expected total is eighty-four euros.

cards.fr: Le reçu indique cent deux euros.
cards.en: The receipt says one hundred and two euros.

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous nous donner une addition détaillée ?
cards.en: Can you give us an itemized bill?

cards.fr: Il y a dix-huit euros de différence.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: L’affiche à l’entrée indique dix-huit euros par menu.
reader.en: The sign at the entrance says eighteen euros per set lunch.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Oui. Quel est le problème avec le reçu ?
reader.en: Yes. What is the problem with the receipt?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous avons commandé quatre menus et trois boissons à quatre euros.
reader.en: We ordered four set lunches and three drinks at four euros each.

reader.speaker: Guide
reader.fr: Quatre menus font soixante-douze euros. Trois boissons font douze euros.
reader.en: Four lunches make seventy-two euros. Three drinks make twelve euros.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le total attendu est de quatre-vingt-quatre euros. Le reçu indique cent deux euros.
reader.en: The expected total is eighty-four euros. The receipt says one hundred and two euros.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Je vais vérifier.
reader.en: I will check.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pouvez-vous nous donner une addition détaillée ? Il y a dix-huit euros de différence.
reader.en: Can you give us an itemized bill? There is an eighteen-euro difference.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Vous avez raison : on vous a facturé cinq menus au lieu de quatre.
reader.en: You are right: you were charged for five set lunches instead of four.

reader.speaker: Guide
reader.fr: Nous réglerons donc quatre-vingt-quatre euros.
reader.en: So we will pay eighty-four euros.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci d’avoir corrigé le reçu.
reader.en: Thank you for correcting the receipt.

speaking.opening: Nous avons commandé quatre menus et trois boissons.
speaking.goal: Narrate the order, compare the eighteen-euro sign price to a five-menu receipt, ask for an itemized bill and settle the corrected eighty-four-euro total.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The prices and resolution are fictional. Arithmetic: four times eighteen plus three times four equals eighty-four; five times eighteen plus twelve equals one hundred two; difference eighteen. Review French number pronunciation.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Talking a Friend Out of Afternoon Ceviche from a Hot Cart
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say no to an unsafe food choice, explain why, and suggest a better option without embarrassing your friend.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a traveler in Lima, and the AI is your friend Diego, with shopkeeper Maribel nearby: say no to the cart ceviche using negative commands (no lo compres) and no recomiendo que + subjunctive, explain why, and kindly suggest a better option.
lessons.title: Suggest a Different Lunch to a Friend
lessons.objective: Decline a friend’s plan to buy raw fish from an unrefrigerated cart, explain the concern and suggest another option without embarrassing them.
lessons.focus: Use negative commands and je ne te recommande pas de to express disagreement, reason and a concrete alternative.
lessons.scene: At an afternoon market, Diego points to raw fish at a cart standing in the sun; Maya suggests a nearby café dish instead.

cards.fr: Je ne te recommande pas de manger ce poisson cru.
cards.en: I do not recommend eating this raw fish.

cards.fr: Il est resté au soleil sans réfrigération.
cards.en: It has been in the sun without refrigeration.
I am worried about food poisoning.
Let us go to the café next door.

cards.fr: On peut prendre un plat chaud.
cards.en: We can have a hot dish.

cards.fr: Je te propose le poulet bien cuit.

reader.speaker: Diego
reader.fr: Je vais prendre le poisson cru à ce chariot.
reader.en: I am going to have the raw fish at that cart.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Attends une seconde. Ne l’achète pas maintenant.
reader.en: Wait a second. Do not buy it now.

reader.speaker: Diego
reader.fr: Pourquoi ?
reader.en: Why?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Il est resté au soleil sans réfrigération. Je crains une intoxication alimentaire.
reader.en: It has been in the sun without refrigeration. I am worried about food poisoning.

reader.speaker: Diego
reader.fr: J’avais envie de poisson.
reader.en: I wanted fish.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je comprends. Je ne te recommande pas de manger ce poisson cru.
reader.en: I understand. I do not recommend eating this raw fish.

reader.speaker: Diego
reader.fr: Tu proposes quoi ?
reader.en: What do you suggest?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Allons au café d’à côté. On peut prendre un plat chaud ou du poulet bien cuit.
reader.en: Let us go to the café next door. We can have a hot dish or well-cooked chicken.

reader.speaker: Diego
reader.fr: D’accord. Allons-y.
reader.en: All right. Let us go.

speaking.opening: Attends une seconde. Ne l’achète pas maintenant.
speaking.goal: Decline the raw-fish cart choice, state the unrefrigerated-sun premise and food-poisoning concern directly, then offer a nearby hot dish.
wordBank: Je ne te recommande pas de manger ce poisson cru.
Il est resté au soleil sans réfrigération.
On peut prendre un plat chaud.
Je te propose le poulet bien cuit.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for food poisoning.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the negative command not to buy it now.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for refrigeration.

say.cueEnglish: State directly why you do not recommend the raw fish.

write.cueEnglish: Write a suggestion to go to the café next door.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Qualified French and food-safety/domain review required. The unrefrigerated cart is an explicit fictional scene premise drawn from the source purpose; clinical term intoxication alimentaire remains learner-facing and direct.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Honest Feedback When the Owner Asks About a New Dish
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Give the owner sincere, specific feedback on a new dish, mixing praise with one tactful recommendation.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a guest at a Montevideo parrilla, and the AI is Graciela, the owner: give your honest opinion of her new vegetarian chivito, praise specific details, and make one tactful recommendation using le recomiendo que and ojalá que with the subjunctive.
lessons.title: Give Honest Feedback on a New Dish
lessons.objective: Praise specific features of a new vegetarian lunch dish and make one tactful suggestion when the owner asks.
lessons.focus: Use j’aime, je trouve que and j’aimerais que + subjunctive to combine concrete praise with a recommendation.
lessons.scene: The owner asks Maya for feedback on a new vegetarian sandwich with grilled vegetables.

cards.fr: J’aimerais que vous mettiez un peu moins de sel.
cards.en: I would like you to use a little less salt.

cards.fr: J’espère que vous le garderez à la carte.
cards.en: I hope you will keep it on the menu.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Vous avez goûté notre nouveau sandwich végétarien. Qu’en pensez-vous ?
reader.en: You tried our new vegetarian sandwich. What do you think?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: J’aime les légumes grillés et le pain est croustillant.
reader.en: I like the grilled vegetables and the bread is crisp.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Et la texture ?
reader.en: And the texture?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Les aubergines sont moelleuses. La présentation est soignée.
reader.en: The eggplants are soft. The presentation is thoughtful.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Vous changeriez quelque chose ?
reader.en: Would you change anything?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: J’aimerais que vous mettiez un peu moins de sel.
reader.en: I would like you to use a little less salt.

reader.speaker: Owner
reader.fr: Merci, c’est précis.
reader.en: Thank you, that is specific.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: J’espère que vous le garderez à la carte.
reader.en: I hope you will keep it on the menu.

speaking.opening: J’aime les légumes grillés et le pain est croustillant.
speaking.goal: Praise the grilled vegetables, bread and presentation, then recommend less salt tactfully and express hope it stays on the menu.
speaking.closure: J’espère que vous le garderez à la carte.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Settling a Group Argument over Where to Eat
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Report what each person and the hostel staff said, and help the group agree on one lunch plan.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are traveling with a group in Medellín, and the AI is Camila, a fellow traveler: report what Joaquín and receptionist Yesenia said using dijo que and comentó que with the imperfect, and help everyone agree on one lunch plan.
lessons.title: Help a Group Agree on Lunch
lessons.objective: Report what each traveler and the host said about lunch choices, then help the group settle on one plan.
lessons.focus: Use a dit que, a expliqué que and imperfect background forms to report preferences before proposing a compromise.
lessons.scene: At a guesthouse, Maya helps three friends choose between a nearby cheap set lunch and a farther bistro.

cards.fr: Camille a dit qu’elle voulait manger près d’ici.
cards.en: Camille said she wanted to eat nearby.

cards.fr: Marc a dit qu’il préférait le bistrot.
cards.en: Marc said he preferred the bistro.

cards.fr: L’hôte a expliqué que le bistrot était complet.
cards.en: The host explained that the bistro was full.

cards.fr: La formule économique est à cinq minutes à pied.
cards.en: The inexpensive set lunch is five minutes away on foot.

cards.fr: Je propose ce restaurant pour aujourd’hui.
cards.en: I suggest this restaurant for today.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Camille, tu voulais déjeuner où ?
reader.en: Camille, where did you want to have lunch?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Près d’ici et sans trop dépenser.
reader.en: Nearby and without spending too much.

reader.speaker: Marc
reader.fr: Je préférais le bistrot de l’autre côté du quartier.
reader.en: I preferred the bistro across the neighborhood.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Camille a dit qu’elle voulait manger près d’ici. Marc a dit qu’il préférait le bistrot.
reader.en: Camille said she wanted to eat nearby. Marc said he preferred the bistro.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Le bistrot est complet aujourd’hui. La formule économique est à cinq minutes à pied.
reader.en: The bistro is full today. The inexpensive set lunch is five minutes away on foot.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: L’hôte a expliqué que le bistrot était complet. Je propose la formule économique pour aujourd’hui.
reader.en: The host explained that the bistro was full. I suggest the inexpensive set lunch for today.

reader.speaker: Marc
reader.fr: D’accord pour aujourd’hui. On essaiera le bistrot demain.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Tout le monde est d’accord ?
reader.en: Does everyone agree?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Oui. Allons-y.
reader.en: Yes. Let us go.
